question: Which still-admissible continuous likelihood model maximally breaks the current robust witness policy, and can the policy be repaired until the whole declared uncertainty box is certified?

continuous_class_v1.name: INDEPENDENT_BINARY_LIKELIHOOD_BOX
continuous_class_v1.likelihood_rows: one independent interval parameter per binary test/cause row; complementary outcome is 1-p
fixed_policy_requirements: no repeated test on a root-to-leaf path

exactness_certificate.statement: For a fixed acyclic policy using each uncertain test at most once per path, policy decision-risk and expected cost are multi-affine in the declared independent binary likelihood parameters (and binary prior parameter when used); therefore maxima over the closed rectangular box are attained at box vertices.
exactness_certificate.consequence: enumerating all 2^d corners is an exact continuous-box extremum certificate for this declared class, not merely a sampled finite approximation

adversary_objectives: maximize generative policy decision-risk = wrong terminal + unresolved terminal + out-of-policy support
independently maximize expected policy cost when a cost gate is declared

benchmarks.synthetic: continuous cheap-sensor degradation must force t_gold before certification
benchmarks.search_proof: continuous provenance/verifier degradation must force a stronger policy before certification
benchmarks.palomar: baseline robust non-identifiability must remain preserved; no invented calibrated likelihoods

next_if_green: EYE-R4.7 may extend the certified class to correlated/polyhedral uncertainty or distributionally robust ambiguity sets without weakening R4.6 firewalls.
